versions.changelog:
- Updated the base URL guidance and example to use `https://api.together.ai`; generated paths include `/v1` and `/v2`.
- Updated the models example to use `SupportedModelsServiceListSupportedModelsWithResponse` and read models from `JSON200.Data`.
- Updated the `go doc` example with the supported-models params type.

go-togetherai 0.1.3

- Added license information (MIT) to metadata.
- Clarified and expanded documentation in SKILL.md, including guidance on finding types and endpoints using Go doc tools.
- Updated endpoint base URL note: some operations may use v2 endpoint.
- Improved error handling description and clarified response wrapper suffixes.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md file.

- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No functional or API changes; only documentation/assets cleanup.

- Initial release of go-togetherai skill.
- Provides a typed Go client for the Together AI REST API with per-endpoint methods generated by oapi-codegen.
- Set up authentication via the TOGETHER_API_KEY environment variable and use strongly-typed response handling.
- Supports key Together AI endpoints: models, chat completions, completions, embeddings, images, fine-tuning, endpoints, and more.
- Designed for use in Go projects needing programmatic access to Together AI functionality.
